text_en: My child, be attentive to my wisdom; incline your ear to my understanding,
text_cn: 我儿，你应注意我的智慧，侧耳倾听我的见解，

text_en: so that you may hold on to prudence, and your lips may guard knowledge.
text_cn: 为使你保持审慎的态度，使你的口唇能固守知识。

text_en: For the lips of a loose woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;
text_cn: 因为淫妇的口，滴流甜蜜；她的嘴唇，比油还滑；

text_en: but in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
text_cn: 但是，与她相处的结果，却苦若苦艾，刺心有如双刃的利剑。

text_en: Her feet go down to death; her steps follow the path to Sheol.
text_cn: 她的双脚陷入死境，她的脚步直趋阴府。

text_en: She does not keep straight to the path of life; her ways wander, and she does not know it.
text_cn: 她不走生命的坦途；她的脚步，踌躇不定，不知所往。

text_en: And now, my child, listen to me, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.
text_cn: 现在，我儿，你要听从我，不要抛弃我口中的教训︰

text_en: Keep your way far from her, and do not go near the door of her house;
text_cn: 你应使你的道路远离她，不要走近她的家门，

text_en: or you will give your honor to others, and your years to the merciless,
text_cn: 免得将你的精力，葬送给别人；将你的岁月，委弃给无赖；

text_en: and strangers will take their fill of your wealth, and your labors will go to the house of an alien;
text_cn: 免得你的财产为他人享受，你的辛劳裨益于人家；

text_en: and at the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are consumed,
text_cn: 免得终期来临，当你的肉躯和身体精力耗尽时，你只有叹息，

text_en: and you say, “Oh, how I hated discipline, and my heart despised reproof!
text_cn: 说：“唉！为什么我憎恶了教训，为什么我的心藐视了规劝？

text_en: I did not listen to the voice of my teachers or incline my ear to my instructors.
text_cn: 为什么我没有听从师长的劝告，没有侧耳倾听教训我的人？

text_en: Now I am at the point of utter ruin in the public assembly. ”
text_cn: 在集会和会众中，我几乎陷于浩劫。”

text_en: Drink water from your own cistern, flowing water from your own well.
text_cn: 你当饮你自己池里的水，喝你井里的活泉。

text_en: Should your springs be scattered abroad, streams of water in the streets?
text_cn: 你的泉水岂可外溢，成为街头的流水？

text_en: Let them be for yourself alone, and not for sharing with strangers.
text_cn: 其实都应全归于你，不得让外人与你共享。

text_en: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice in the wife of your youth,
text_cn: 你的泉源理应受祝福；你应由你少年时的妻子取乐。

text_en: a lovely deer, a graceful doe. May her breasts satisfy you at all times; may you be intoxicated always by her love.
text_cn: 她宛如可爱的母鹿，妩媚的母羚；她的酥胸应常使你畅怀，她的爱情应不断使你陶醉。

text_en: Why should you be intoxicated, my son, by another woman and embrace the bosom of an adulteress?
text_cn: 我儿，你为什么要迷恋外妇，拥抱别人妻室的胸怀？

text_en: For human ways are under the eyes of the Lord , and he examines all their paths.
text_cn: 上主的眼目时常监视人的道路，不断审察他的一切行径。

text_en: The iniquities of the wicked ensnare them, and they are caught in the toils of their sin.
text_cn: 恶人必被自己的邪恶所缠扰，必为自己罪恶的罗网所捕获。

text_en: They die for lack of discipline, and because of their great folly they are lost.
text_cn: 他必因不听教训而丧命，必因自己过度的愚昧而沦亡。
